page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The animal side
steps.why: Milk yield depends first on which animals are kept and how they are looked after.
common_mistakes: Leaving out management of the animals.
steps.memory_tip: First the animals, then the milk.
steps.margin_note: Two numbered factors cover the two marks.
lines: 1. Breeding, feeding and management of milk

steps.label: The milk side
steps.why: Dairying is an industry, so the milk has to be processed and sold as well as produced.
common_mistakes: Stopping at production. Processing and marketing are part of it.
steps.memory_tip: Produce it, process it, sell it.

lines.text: 2. Production, processing and marketing of milk

insider_note: Two halves: the animals, and the milk. Answering only 'breeding and feeding' is half an answer.
